message: 虫

name: Paqy
message: 「Brrr, it's freezing! I wanna huddle up and play oshikura manju alone with Ria-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not even possible--that's a game you play with a whole group, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「B-b-brrr... It's still autumn, yet the moment the wind blows, it steals all your body heat」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wait, have you lost your mind, Synn-sama?! What's the big idea climbing up to an even colder hill like this!」

name: Synn
message: 「Scouting it out. We might be able to use this place」

name: Paqy
message: 「As a training ground for the Crusaders?」

name: Synn
message: 「You catch on quick, Paqy」
Yes, the demons we fought yesterday were tough.
No, purely in terms of raw strength, if it had been one-on-one, we might have been able to repel them with the same carefree mood as before.
However, just like the Crusaders do, the demons covered for one another and launched coordinated attacks.

name: Synn
message: 「Even demons care about their comrades the exact same way we do. That gives us even less reason to fight」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's the kind of line you're only allowed to say after you can actually hold your own in a fight」
I'm at a loss for words. Paqy has a point. Whatever happens from here on out, it definitely can't hurt to train our Guardian Angel abilities.
The plaza up on the hill should make a good candidate for a training ground.
Sports clubs run here during the day, but at night after everyone goes home, nobody comes near. We won't have to worry about anyone getting caught in Crusaders training and hurt.

name: Misa
message: 「Ugh, it's so cold!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura-kun?!」
From the direction of Finis Tower, Misa came jogging over at a brisk trot, as if trying to outrun the autumn wind.

name: Synn
message: 「I get it, you came here to scout the place out too, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, that's right」

name: Misa
message: 「Gasp?! N-n-n-no I didn't! Don't go acting like you can read my mind!」

name: Misa
message: 「I was... That's right! I was lying in wait because I wanted to challenge you to a match, Sakura-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-out here? If you mean an endurance contest against the cold, I'd rather pass......」

name: Misa
message: 「I'd refuse that too!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ummm, let's see...」

name: Misa
message: 「L-Look over there, at that tree. There's a bird perched on the branch, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「If it stays still for thirty seconds, I get twenty points! I'll go first! One... two... three...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, come on, that challenge is way too unreasonable.」

name: Misa
message: 「Shut up! Well then, what else do you expect me to do!?」

name: Misa
message: 「C-Cold...!! Achoo!」

name: Synn
message: 「Girls' uniforms really leave you defenseless against the wind. If you want, should I lend you Paqy? He can double as a hand warmer.」

name: Misa
message: 「You mean it!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「If it's an order from Master Synn, I can't exactly say no.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ahh, Mr. Paqy...」
Misa reaches her hands out toward Paqy.

name: Misa
message: 「*Ding!* Sakura-kun didn't mention a single thing about a return deadline. Therefore, even if I borrow him for the rest of my life, there are no legal issues...」

name: Paqy
message: 「N-No way! Hiss's eyes are dead serious!!」

name: Misa
message: 「N-Nooo, a huge mosquito is flying right at me...! Eek!?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a crane fly. It doesn't suck blood, so it'd be a shame to swat it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Stop being so carefree and shoo it away already! Ugh, ughhh!」

name: Synn
message: 「Here, calm down... I got it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Phew...! Reluctant as I am, I shall express my gratitude. Thank you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Crane fly?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, what's the big idea showing more interest in an insect than in my thanks!?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, it's a summer bug, right? Isn't it rare to see one at the start of autumn?」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed it is.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? You came here with Shio-chan?」

name: Misa
message: 「No? Shio, what are you doing out here all alone? You'll catch a cold, come on, let's head back」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, I am a shrine maiden of Asukai. Drawn here by this unnaturally fierce wind, I came to investigate, and lo...」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--!? A-Another one came flying over!」

name: Shio
message: 「The Two Hundred Tenth Day has long since passed, and yet wind bugs are still dancing about...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wind bugs?」

name: Shio
message: 「I refer to crane flies. Normally, with the Holy Night Festival coming next month, I ought to summon snow bugs as a good omen, yet... what a blunder!」

name: Shio
message: 「It seems the wind-calming ritual I performed in late summer was incomplete」

name: Shio
message: 「When the wind blows this hard and the atmosphere grows restless, all manner of bugs spring forth. I shall return to the shrine at once and redo the ritual!」

name: Synn
message: 「Bugs... Does that include things like a 'premonition bug'?」

name: Shio
message: 「They are much the same, indeed. Temper bugs, crybabies, weaklings--there are all sorts, you know」

name: Misa
message: 「...Then what about a 'worry bug'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa?」

name: Shio
message: 「Naturally, those exist as well」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, as much as I would love to chat, I am in a hurry, so I bid you farewell!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll help!」

name: Shio
message: 「I gratefully accept the sentiment alone. This, at least, is a duty I must see through by myself!」
Before long, the wind gradually shifted, bringing with it clear air that hinted at the arrival of winter.
The sunset was dazzling. Perhaps thanks to that, the chill of dread from last night's battle began to soften.

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan pulled it off, didn't she」

name: Synn
message: 「A 'worry bug,' huh... Misa's amazing, isn't she, Paqy? She figured it out right away」

name: Paqy
message: 「Phew, good grief. Now I don't gotta worry about getting abducted by Hisu」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, you're relieved about the completely wrong thing」
